https://rausgegangen.de/events/a-berlin-.description: A BERLIN DRAG QUEENS CHRISTMAS SHOW 🎄✨Dieses Weihnachten bringt DUCT TAPE die Berliner Drag-Szene für zwei ganz besondere Abende im Theater im Delphi zusammen.Am 4. und 5. https://rausgegangen.de/events/drag-brun.description: HALLOWEEN DRAG BRUNCH 🎃🦇Duct Tape und Fritz-Kola laden euch zum schaurigsten Drag Brunch des Jahres ein!Am Samstag, den 31. Oktober, feiern wir Halloween im The Dawn Neukölln. Alle, die im Kostüm kommen, bekommen ein Getränk aufs Haus. https://rausgegangen.de/events/house-of-.description: HOUSE OF PRIDE 2027 | edition #s6xBERLIN’S QUEEREST MAIN PARTYJuly 24, 2027. Berlin Pride hits its peak — and House of Pride takes over after the Parade.For one unforgettable night our multi-venue Ritter Butzke, AQUAHŌFE Berlin & Kreuzwerk transform into a massive queer playground in the heart of Berlin: seven areas, indoor & outdoor, packed with beats, 50+ performers & djs, wild energy and thousands of people coming together to celebrate exactly who they are.House of Pride is not just another party. It’s a statement. A celebration. A beautiful, sweaty, loud and unapologetic explosion of queer culture. The event supports Berlin Pride and a beneficial project every year! From house to techno, disco to pop, RnB, rave & to everything in between, expect a genre-hopping journey through some of Berlin’s most iconic spaces — with 50+ artists, spectacular performances and enough energy to carry you through 12+ hours of Pride night.Come for the music. Stay for the madness. Dance with strangers. Kiss whoever you want. Lose yourself in the crowd.No labels. No limits. No judgment. Just Pride.HOUSE OF PRIDE 2027July 24, 2027 | 21:00 7 AREAS · INDOOR & OUTDOOR 50+ ARTISTS · 5 GENRES 3,500+ PEOPLE · 12+ HOURS KREUZBERG · BERLINThe official Main Party of Berlin Pride | CSD Berlin 2027.Headliner & Line-Up: TBAThis is your Pride night. Make it c(o)unt.
